owner_and_team_credentials: Began as The Compassionate Kitchen before evolving into The Cake People. Voted Australia's Family Business on Kochie's Business Builders (2021). 2026 BAA Victorian Baking Show Champions (Taste category). 100% plant-based cakes have won multiple awards. Extensive experience crafting custom, allergen-friendly celebration cakes for a wide range of occasions.
why_started: A shared passion for beautiful, delicious cakes and the joy they bring to every occasion. Started as The Compassionate Kitchen, driven to create plant-based cakes that did not compromise on taste or quality. Saw a market gap for cakes catering to all dietary needs — egg free, dairy free, gluten friendly, nut free, soy free, and fully vegan — without sacrificing the artistry and deliciousness of a celebration cake. Wanted to make it simple for everyone to enjoy a stunning, bespoke cake regardless of dietary requirements or allergies. Evolved into The Cake People, staying true to planet-friendly, sustainable ingredients so every bite can be savoured with a clear conscience.
usps: Award-winning, 100% plant-based cakes — multiple awards including 2026 BAA Victorian Baking Show Champions (Taste), proving exceptional taste without compromise
Sustainable and ethical practices using planet-friendly ingredients — celebrate with a clear conscience
Comprehensive allergen-friendly options (egg free, dairy free, gluten friendly, nut free, soy free, fully vegan) — all in one place
Fully bespoke, custom cake design service — 'You Dream it... We Make it!'
Strong awards and star-rating reputation to feature prominently
